item.text: {"summary":"The failures span coarser Unix conversions, nanosecond and Universal conversions, and the int64 lower-bound seconds case. The supplied excerpts show some conversions use fast paths for nonnegative values and otherwise rely on flooring helpers, but omit those helpers and the time representation arithmetic needed to identify a concrete repair.","hypotheses":["Negative values in the shared floor-to-unit conversion path are rounded toward zero for sub-unit remainders.","The seconds conversion helper mishandles rounding or saturation near the minimum int64 value.","The conversion failures may share a lower-level duration representation or rounding defect."],"queries":["FloorToUnit(","ToInt64Seconds(","FromUnixDuration(","GetRepHi("],"reads":[{"path":"absl/time/time.cc","line":0,"symbol":"FloorToUnit"},{"path":"absl/time/time.cc","line":0,"symbol":"ToInt64Seconds"},{"path":"absl/time/internal/time.h","line":0,"symbol":"FromUnixDuration"},{"path":"absl/time/duration.h","line":0,"symbol":"Floor"}],"ready":false}
